intervention: Whole-candidate residual reranker of the already displayed exact-code candidates; bounded short surface, clause-boundary and skipped marker/role relations. Preserve candidate pool, confidence filtering and explicit personal ordering.
training: 800 new HKCanCor training utterances,600 Tatoeba training families,240 prior authored training variants. Exclude old HK pair-training targets and known validation/heldout targets6+; only candidates from the pinned current decoder are competing pairs; target must already be displayed. Collapse related candidates and authored/community variants to a family observation.
features: Surface2..4 Han characters; pair relations at distance2..5 with at least one closed-class marker; start/end1..3; shared first/end role and length bucket. Max2 occurrences per feature per candidate. No full-sentence feature.
validation_amendment: After the initial role-schema1 trial failed authored-validation top5, split ordering/adverb markers就先再都又 into M and determiner啲 into B; previously conflated O/O skip features penalized legitimate先覆 continuations. Freeze role-schema2 and the unchanged parameter/strength grid before any heldout decoding. Schema1 rejection and validation results are retained; no heldout results inform this refinement.
parity_correction: Before inspecting post-selection guard rankings, Python/Java parity checks revealed newer CJK candidates reset Python history but not Java. Use the same explicit CJK blocks through ExtensionJ in both feature extractors, retrain unchanged parameters and reselect on validation only. Prior selections are retained; no post-selection guard score guides the correction.
structural_gate: The first whole-candidate trial fails completion16 after improving natural200; it is rejected. A followup intervention protects the original winner only when existing completion,handover,clause and clause-start scorers provide positive support: a candidate with less support cannot overtake it. Equal/stronger-supported candidates still rerank. Reuse unchanged trained weights and reselect the same strength grid on validation only. Earlier guards are now diagnostic; freeze another100 excluded-conversation utterances before selection and evaluate them only afterwards.
conservative_gate_amendment: Before evaluating the new followup100, the weak gate still loses two previously correct handover first choices and three authored clause probes through equal-support lexical substitutions. Preserve the original first choice whenever it has positive existing structural support, while reranking the remaining candidates; unsupported originals can still be replaced. This is a conservative known-construction tradeoff, not full-sentence matching. Reselect on validation only, keep earlier attempts, and require handover/authored70 top1 as additional guards.
gate_ordering: Preserve a positively supported original through stable first-position precedence, then sort all other candidates by their unmodified baseline-plus-residual scores. Do not clip their relative scores to the winner. Finalize this ordering before viewing the new followup100 rankings.
selection: Compare zero against the fixed strength grid on existing authored60,natural200,Tatoeba200 validation sets. Require no aggregate top1/top5 loss in any validation set; choose highest mean MRR, ties lower strength. No eligible positive strength means reject.
guards: After selection is written, evaluate fresh100 natural utterances and reused natural200,authored120,old600,daily32,completion16,Tatoeba200,public100,authored70. Require natural200,old600,daily32,completion16 top1/top5 and fresh100 top1/top5 no lower; preserved candidate membership must retain top20. Single-learning simulation remains32/32 first choices. Paired CPU0 12-warmup/15-sample median latency ratio<=1.2.
release: No new APK unless the existing1.0 release gate is met. An eligible validation strength is not evidence of real-user HK-chat accuracy; old cases and validation sets are diagnostic/reused. Record rejected trials.
limits: Whole-candidate rescoring cannot recover a sentence lost during beam search. Source examples are older spoken conversations and public community sentences; authored variants are correlated. These features supply evidence, not grammatical proof.
